user.title: Select the AC
user.description: Devices advertising a name starting with "KT2026" are shown as probable OutEquip Pro AC units. Pick one, or enter a MAC address manually if yours isn't listed.

manual.title: Enter the AC's BLE MAC address
manual.description: No candidates were found nearby, or you chose manual entry. The MAC is printed on/near the AC's control module, or can be found with a BLE scanner app.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add this AC?
bluetooth_confirm.description: Home Assistant found a probable OutEquip Pro AC: {name}. Add it?

error.invalid_mac: Not a valid MAC address (expected format AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF)
